meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 cobrapy 分析代谢模型:运行 FBA、FVA 等模拟,做基因敲除、通量采样,读取和保存 SBML/JSON/YAML 模型,并支持培养基优化等。它需要 Python 3.9 以上环境。
howto.when: 当你要求加载或构建代谢模型、运行 FBA/FVA 等通量分析,或做基因敲除等操作时触发。模型可从本地文件或 BiGG/BioModels 在线获取。

say.text: 对 iJO1366 做单基因敲除筛选,列出必需基因。
say.note: 返回各基因缺失后的生长情况。

say.text: 算一下 textbook 模型在目标生长率下的最小培养基。
say.note: 返回最少需要的培养基成分。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to use cobrapy for constraint-based analysis of metabolic models: FBA, FVA, gene/reaction knockouts, flux sampling, SBML/JSON/YAML model I/O, and media optimization. Requires Python 3.9+.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to load or build a metabolic model, run FBA/FVA flux analyses, or perform gene knockouts. Models can come from local files or online via BiGG/BioModels.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model with load_model, run FBA, and print the growth rate.
say_en.note: Returns the optimal growth rate and flux distribution.

say_en.text: Run a single-gene deletion screen on iJO1366 and list essential genes.
say_en.note: Reports growth for each gene deletion.

say_en.text: Compute a minimal medium for the textbook model at a target growth rate.
